spans.s:
m. (-तः)
Light, lustre.
E.
उद्, द्युत to shine, aff.

m. (-द्यः)
A river.
E.
उद् water, and य what goes, from या to go, and ड aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Raised, held up.
2 Active, persevering, labouring diligently and incessantly.
3 Trained, exercised, disciplined.
m. (-तः)
A section, a chapter, the division of a book.
E.
उद् before यम to cease, affix क्त.

m. (-मः)
1 Strenuous and continued effort, exertion, perseverance.
2 Taking or lifting up.
E.
उद् reverse, यम to cease, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Persevering, active, making effort.
E.
उद्यम and इनि aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Requiring exertion.
ind.
Having lifted or taken up.
2 Having made exertion.
E.
उद् before यम to cease, यत् and ल्यप् affs.

n. (-नं)
1 A garden.
2 A royal garden, a park.
3 Going forth, exit.
4 Purpose, motive.
E.
उद् up, या to go, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
A gardener.
2 The master or owner of a garden.
E.
उद्यान and पाल who takes care of.

m. (-वः)
Mixing, joining.
E.
उद् before यु to mix, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Zealously active, labouring for some desired end.
E.
उद्, युज to join, क्त affix; also उद्यत.

m. (-गः)
Exertion, perseverance, strenuous and continued endeavour.
E.
उद्, युज to join, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Active, laborious, persevering, one who makes effort.
E.
उद्योग and इनि aff.
